evidence_note: Paths and release receipts record implementation and deployment state. Provider credentials and private logs remain excluded.

items.title: Complete conversations, knowledge workspace, MCP and Python SDK
items.public_claim: v0.3 live service supports explicit paginated conversation storage/search and a read-only official-SDK MCP endpoint. Source-linked wiki/topic-graph organization is deployed but disabled until model provider/cost approval; Python client source and local wheel are available, not PyPI.

items.title: Evidence retrieval, bounded context and read-only memory review
items.public_claim: The live v0.3 service searches retained current-version source evidence, packs complete records within a character budget, and reports duplicate text, slot differences and old sources. No learned consolidation is claimed.

items.title: Vercel AI SDK 7 integration
items.public_claim: Private source adapter provides scoped retrieval middleware, read-only tools, and explicit user-message writes. Offline framework checks and local v0.1.0/v0.2.1 compatibility checks pass; no npm publication or real-model quality claim.

items.title: Explicit memory lifecycle
items.public_claim: Save, read, update, inspect history, deactivate, delete, and export records with pagination.

items.title: User-scoped access
items.public_claim: User scope is enforced by the server; read-only and read/write keys are supported.

items.title: Chinese and English lexical retrieval
items.public_claim: Find currently active explicit memories without calling a model.

items.title: Management console and request records
items.public_claim: Inspect sources, history, keys, and request status. Credentials are currently assigned by an administrator.

items.title: Typed TypeScript / JavaScript SDK and OpenAPI
items.public_claim: Download the typed server SDK and OpenAPI 3.1 specification for online v0.1. The package is hosted on the website, not the npm registry.

items.title: Automatic extraction and review
items.public_claim: The local candidate validates sources and routes uncertain changes to review. Real-model validation is incomplete.

items.title: Controlled fact slots and review reasons
items.public_claim: The local candidate normalizes clearly equivalent fields. Ambiguous or unregistered fields still require review.

items.title: Qwen semantic and hybrid retrieval
items.public_claim: The adapter is implemented. Approved credentials and real-effectiveness validation remain prerequisites; semantic retrieval is not offered on the live service.

items.title: Metadata, categories, and validity windows
items.public_claim: The local API candidate supports categories, flat metadata, and validity windows. New console forms are not yet available.

items.title: Compound filters and validity-window retrieval
items.public_claim: The local API candidate supports AND/OR/NOT filters. This is not historical reasoning or snapshot querying.

items.title: Quality evaluation material
items.public_claim: Synthetic cases and engineering regression checks exist. There are no independent blind-review, customer-outcome, or competitive-ranking results.

items.title: User profiles
items.public_claim: Planned. No Profile API is available.

items.title: MCP OAuth and write tools
items.public_claim: Read-only scoped Streamable HTTP MCP is live in v0.3. OAuth onboarding, prompts, persistent MCP sessions and write tools are not available.

items.title: npm registry and Python SDK releases
items.public_claim: Planned for registries. A typed TypeScript/JavaScript download, private-source development client, and dependency-free Python client source are available; no npm or PyPI publication.

items.title: Unified asynchronous tasks, webhooks, and feedback
items.public_claim: Existing ingestion states are not a unified asynchronous queue. Notification and feedback endpoints are not available.

items.title: Self-service access, usage, and budgets
items.public_claim: Self-service signup and billing are not available. Administrators issue keys for the developer preview.

items.title: Organizations, SSO, and enterprise delivery
items.public_claim: Enterprise SSO, production capacity, backup recovery, and compliance certification have not been validated. No SLA is offered.
